text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: all 16 tests run and report OK. I didn't touch the tests. The fixes in `catalog/`:

- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist (`catalog.nonexistent`). It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int.
- **`factory.py`**: `sample_books()` was missing Emma, so I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copy count are my choice. The tests only check the title.
- **`fees.py`**: `late_fee` added the daily fee to the number of days instead of multiplying. It now multiplies.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned `n+1` events. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`members.py`**: `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, but the policy comment and the tests say 5. I set it to 5.
